record_type_quote:
The  original  study  (N=100)  and  our  replication  (N=389)  tested  whether  a  series  of  40  popular  logo  and  character  images  show  evidence  of  a  Visual
Mandela Effect (VME).

targets.title: The Visual Mandela Effect as Evidence for Shared and Speciﬁc False Memories Across People
targets.evidence_quote:
We ran a replication of Study 1 from: Prasad, D., & Bainbridge, W. A. (2022). The Visual Mandela Effect as Evidence for Shared and Speciﬁc False

Memories Across People. Psychological Science, 33(12), 1971–1988. https://doi.org/10.1177/09567976221108944
targets.outcome_quote: All of the study’s main ﬁndings replicated.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall verdict governs the new-sample replication. Original-data reanalyses and methodological criticisms are also reported, but the report treats all main replication findings as replicated.

reasoning: Completed new-sample replication of Study 1 of one published paper. The overall replication verdict is explicit.
